articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset
articles.description: After Seth Trimble led Louisville to a 72-64 win over No. 5 Texas Tech, Cardinals coach Pat Kelsey told critics of teams using fifth-year players, "Everybody can have their opinion. Bring it."

article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Chace Watley had 29 points in Wofford’s 91-86 victory over Winthrop on Saturday. Watley also had five rebounds for the Terriers (4-3). Jyi Dawkins scored 20 points, going 8 of 9 (3 for 3 from 3-point range). Chris Arias had 13 points and shot 3 for 9 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. Keshawn Fisher finished with 31 points, four assists and five steals for the Eagles (0-6). Winthrop also got 16 points from Anthony Smith III. Spence Sims also had 12 points. The Eagles prolonged their losing streak to six straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
